description: Gateway access of one User. The User's own roles and permissions still decide what each request may read or write.

fields.label: API Enabled
fields.description: Lets the user exchange its API Key / API Secret (User > API Access) for a gateway access token.

fields.label: Extra Params
fields.description: Applied to every request against the DocType: lists are filtered by it, a document outside it answers 404, new documents get it and updates cannot move a document out of it. Several rows with the same DocType and Field allow any of their values.

fields.label: Integration Data
fields.description: A JSON object other apps read while serving this user's requests, e.g. {"token": "..."}. They may add keys of their own (cached data); never sent to API clients.

name: Fraxis User Profile
